room_rent.note: Single AC room incl. boarding & nursing as provided by hospital; proportionate deduction if higher room opted

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges with no separate % cap stated

copayment.note: No flat co-pay; 10% co-pay ONLY if Zone-II insured treated in Zone-I (Clause 5.29); not on accidents or sub-limited treatments

sub_limits.note: Cataract 10% of SI / ₹50k per eye; modern treatments capped; genetic/mental 25%; main inpatient otherwise up to SI

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting only 24 months (better than other NIA plans)

specific_disease_waiting.note: Tiered 90 days / 12 mo / 24 mo lists; listed-disease bulk at 12 months

cumulative_bonus.note: +25% SI per claim-free year, max 100%; reduced at same rate on claim

restoration.note: Reinstatement of full SI once per policy period; only for unrelated illness/injury; individual SI policies only; not for modern treatments

organ_donor.note: Donor hospitalisation expenses (excl. organ cost) within SI (Clause 3.4)

ambulance.note: Road ambulance 1% of SI up to ₹5,000; plus ₹5,000 home transfer on discharge

modern_treatments.note: Listed modern treatments capped per procedure (e.g. robotic 10%/₹75k; immunotherapy ₹50k)

consumables.note: Cost of pharmacy & consumables, implants, devices payable (Clause 3.1)

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity & domiciliary hospitalisation excluded; standard IRDAI Excl01-18

optional_riders.display: Zone-based cover options (Zone I/II); hazardous sports cover
